2607.26909.title: Dual-Path LLM Reasoning for Multimodal Few-Shot Knowledge Graph Completion
2607.26909.paper_summary: Knowledge graph completion (KGC) aims to infer missing facts in knowledge graphs (KGs), thereby improving their completeness and supporting downstream intelligent applications. However, emerging entities and relations in real-world deployments make inductive KGC difficult, especially under few-shot and zero-shot settings. Multimodal information and Large Language Model (LLM)-derived priors can enrich sparse relational contexts, but they may also introduce noisy or hallucinated evidence. To address these issues, we propose DuPLeR, a \textbf{Du}al-\textbf{P}ath \textbf{L}LM \textbf{R}easoning framework for multimodal few-shot KGC. DuPLeR builds a calibrated relation graph by combining multimodal LLM-derived type priors with factual support structures, and performs dual-level structural reasoning over the refined relation topology. Moreover, a dual-pathway multimodal enhancement module regulates message passing with query-relevant multimodal signals and supplements entity representations after graph propagation. Experiments on eight inductive variants of two multimodal KG (MMKG) benchmarks show that DuPLeR achieves robust performance in data-scarce KGC scenarios.
2607.26909.paper_summary_zh: 知識圖譜補全（KGC）旨在推斷知識圖譜（KGs）中缺失的事實，從而提高其完整性並支持下游智能應用。然而，現實世界中的新興實體和關係使得歸納式 KGC 變得困難，特別是在少量樣本和零樣本的情境下。多模態信息和大型語言模型（LLM）衍生的先驗知識可以豐富稀疏的關係背景，但它們也可能引入噪聲或幻覺證據。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了 DuPLeR，一個 \textbf{Du}al-\textbf{P}ath \textbf{L}LM \textbf{R}easoning 框架，用於多模態少樣本 KGC。DuPLeR 通過結合多模態 LLM 衍生的類型先驗和事實支持結構來構建一個經過校準的關係圖，並對精煉的關係拓撲進行雙層結構推理。此外，一個雙通道多模態增強模塊通過查詢相關的多模態信號調節消息傳遞，並在圖形傳播後補充實體表示。在兩個多模態 KG（MMKG）基準的八個歸納變體上的實驗顯示，DuPLeR 在數據稀缺的 KGC 情境中達到了穩健的性能。
